name: Riverbend Summer Camp at The Wetherill School
description_short: A first camp for 4, 5 and 6 year olds who have not started kindergarten, led by Riverbend counselors on The Wetherill School's wooded seven acre campus in Gladwyne. Children walk forest trails, gather for songs and stories, play with water and in the gardens, and have child sized indoor classrooms.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 a week deposit is due at booking and is a non-refundable administration fee, as are transaction fees. Tuition balances are due in full and become non-refundable on June 1.
notes: One weekly rate of $625. Hours 9:15 to 3:00, Monday to Friday. Only for children who have not yet started kindergarten. 2027 dates are still to be announced; the hub expects July to mid August. Registration for 2027 opens December 11, 2026.
